purpose: capture what the fixed production runtime-identity producer returns, without invoking Modal

app_id.reason: Modal SDK 1.5.5 exposes no running-app accessor to a function container: modal.running_app is a module and not a callable, and the runtime-context API (modal.current_function_call_id, modal.current_input_id, modal.interact, modal.is_local) carries no application id. The application id of this run is a client-side fact of the provider-issued App.app_id of the running app.

app_page_url.reason: the Modal runtime exposes no app page URL to a function container: the only candidate inside the container was modal.running_app, which is a module and not a callable in Modal SDK 1.5.5, while the supported App.get_dashboard_url() is a client-side API of the SDK. The app page URL of this run is a client-side fact of the provider.

container_id.reason: the running container exposed neither MODAL_WORKER_ID (the Modal SDK reads the worker id from the 'worker_id' configuration setting, which the runtime sets only for internal debugging) nor HOSTNAME (a Modal function container sets no hostname), so the worker itself could not attest its container identity; the provider-issued container id of this run is a client-side fact of the provider's container list

function_call_id.reason: the Modal runtime did not expose a function-call id to this process (modal.current_function_call_id() returns no id outside a Modal function container)

statement: This is a local capture of the production producer, executed against the installed Modal SDK 1.5.5 outside a Modal container. No Modal invocation was made, no worker was deployed or touched, and the capture holds no provider-issued identifier: outside a Modal container the function-call id and the container id are NOT_AVAILABLE, which is exactly what the producer reports there. The OBSERVED branches of the producer are exercised by the test suite in a simulated container context.
